guard.note: every effect (novelty / attack sounds, pre-boss and boss music) sits behind an instanceof test of one of the 14 listed classes (10 in 2.5.58.4); the rest reads the option, the capability target, the owner and a tag
a read: the capability's target id, then Level.getEntity

goety_boss_music_class_gate.conversion: Mixin @Inject at the head of ClientEvents.onEntityTick (cancellable): returns at once when the ticked entity's class is none of the 14 classes the handler acts on (decided once per class by name through its superclasses: bons.furious.patch.goety_boss_music_gates.GoetyMusicGates); otherwise the handler runs unchanged
